label: Ubiquiti UniFi Mobile Router Ultra (UMR-Ultra)
description: UniFi Mobile Router Ultra: 2x 100M RJ45, LTE Cat 4, WiFi 4, USB-C or 9-30 V DC, DIN/wall mount, no PoE.
notes: Vendor figures: **(2) FE RJ45 ports** - fast ethernet - **LTE Cat 4**, WiFi 4 1x1, **5.7 W**, USB-C 5 V/2 A or **9-30 V DC** on a 4-pin ATX header, **-30 to 70 C** operating. **The "Ultra" is the lesser unit**: against the UMR it drops both ports from gigabit to 100M, loses PoE entirely, and gives up LTE band coverage - in exchange for a wider DC input range, a wider temperature range and one third less power. The name does not rank the hardware.
